   568  /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------
   569   * Function:    H5MM_memcpy
   570   *
   571   * Purpose:     Like memcpy(3) but with sanity checks on the parameters,
   572   *              particularly buffer overlap.
   573   *
   574   * Return:      Success:    pointer to dest
   575   *              Failure:    NULL
   576   *
   577   * Programmer:  Dana Robinson
   578   *              Spring 2019
   579   *
   580   *-------------------------------------------------------------------------
   581   */
   582  void *
   583  H5MM_memcpy(void *dest, const void *src, size_t n)
   584  {
   585      void *ret = NULL;
   586
   587      /* Use FUNC_ENTER_NOAPI_NOINIT_NOERR here to avoid performance issues */
   588      FUNC_ENTER_NOAPI_NOINIT_NOERR
   589
   590      HDassert(dest);
   591      HDassert(src);
   592
   593      /* Check for buffer overlap */
   594      HDassert((char *)dest >= (const char *)src + n || (const char *)src >= (char *)dest + n);
   595
   596      /* Copy */
   597      ret = HDmemcpy(dest, src, n);
   598
   599      FUNC_LEAVE_NOAPI(ret)
   600
   601  } /* end H5MM_memcpy() */
